chatLines: Saw runners near the gas station.

Need more wood before winter.

Keep the gate shut after dark.

My feet are killing me.

Somebody left the well bucket out again.
The banker counts every coin twice.
We need a second fire on the east side.
Stay close to the walls at night.

Water tastes off today.
